headline: Sensex Surpasses 81,000 and Nifty Reclaims 25,000 as Markets Recover from Day's Lows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing crude oil prices provided support to market sentiment.
Strong buying in banking stocks helped benchmarks recover from initial losses.
Bulls maintained a firm grip as markets staged a recovery after early profit-taking.
Selling pressure in IT stocks early in the session initially dragged indices down before recovery.
whatHappening: Sensex closed over 100 points higher, surpassing 81,000, while Nifty settled above 25,000.
Rupee strengthened by 5 paise to close at 93.93 against the U.S. dollar.
Indian stock exchanges (BSE and NSE) will remain closed on November 10 for Diwali Balipratipada.
Indian government bonds continued their rally ahead of upcoming inflation data releases.
summary: Indian equity benchmarks ended in the green on November 9, with Sensex closing above 81,000 and Nifty reclaiming 25,000. Easing crude oil prices and banking stock buying helped indices stage a strong recovery from early trade declines caused by IT sector selling. Equity markets will remain shut on November 10 for Diwali Balipratipada.
